title: Why did one stale package name stop a StagOS build?

cast.name: Sam
cast.role: Release engineer on the broken build

cast.name: Dara
cast.role: StagOS maintainer who knows why the recovery target went away

glossary.full: The list of module names a product installs

glossary.note: Virtual A/B keeps the second slot as snapshots.

key_points: PRODUCT_PACKAGES accumulates across every inherited makefile.
Each name in it must match a real module, or the build stops.
Removing the stale name from both compression makefiles fixes the error.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A StagOS build. A single letter at the prompt, and it stops.

beats.speaker: sam
beats.text: Non-existent modules? I haven't added a package all week.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These lines are condensed from the build's own check in build/make's main.mk. It lists every package name that no module answers to.
beats.say: These lines are condensed from the build's own check in build make's main dot m k. It lists every package name that no module answers to.

beats.speaker: dara
beats.text: Nobody added one. A name went stale. Find where it's listed.

beats.speaker: sam
beats.text: Here it is. Two makefiles, both for Virtual A/B compression.
beats.say: Here it is. Two makefiles, both for Virtual A B compression.

beats.speaker: dara
beats.text: Your device makefile never lists these. It inherits them, through chains like this.

beats.speaker: dara
beats.text: Each inherited makefile adds to the package list. Lists pile up; scalars like the product name take the most derived value.

beats.speaker: sam
beats.text: So one stale name anywhere in the chain lands in my list.

beats.speaker: dara
beats.text: That a recovery build of snapuserd still exists. The real commit says the recovery target was removed in an earlier change.
beats.say: That a recovery build of snap user d still exists. The real commit says the recovery target was removed in an earlier change.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The fix in StagOS build/make: remove the non existent snapuserd.recovery package. Its diff, trimmed:
beats.say: The fix in Stag O S build make: remove the non existent snap user d dot recovery package. Its diff, trimmed:

beats.speaker: sam
beats.text: One name out, and snapuserd drops its trailing backslash, because it's last in the list now.
beats.say: One name out, and snap user d drops its trailing backslash, because it's last in the list now.

beats.speaker: dara
beats.text: Same change in the retrofit file. Two files touched.

beats.speaker: sam
beats.text: And now nothing in this folder names the recovery build.

beats.speaker: dara
beats.text: The commit's test note: run m, and that error is no longer present.
